{{Top|leg}}
'''Beacon Base''' was a large [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The base was operated by a resistance group, and it supported the operations of resistance fighters from throughout the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was situated near to [[Phelar Port/Legends|Phelar Port]], beneath an abandoned [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] assembly facility.
